Greg Levy

Other-party candidate candidate for United States Senate (Unexpired Term Ending 01/03/2029), Ohio · Challenger

Community organizer and musician; military veteran

Greg Levy is an Akron-born military veteran and community organizer who lives in University Heights. He is the Party for Socialism and Liberation's candidate and is on Ohio's ballot as an independent in the November 3, 2026 special election for the U.S. Senate seat formerly held by JD Vance. He filed his FEC statement of candidacy on 2025-09-03 and announced his run in October 2025.

Where Levy stands

Cost of living
Says higher costs come from an economy organized around corporate profit over workers. Supports a $30 per hour minimum wage and capping rent at 20% of a person's paycheck.
Health care
Supports universal free health care.
Public services
Supports universal public services, including free education and child care.
Immigration
Says he would abolish ICE and end deportations.
Defense spending
Proposes cutting the defense budget by 90 percent and says he wants an end to 'forever wars.'
Reparations
Supports reparations for Black Americans.
Campaign finance
Does not accept money from corporations or PACs. Says his campaign has no ties to the outside PAC mailers promoting him and condemns them as deceiving voters.

Background

  • Grew up in Akron, Ohio; joined the military at 18
  • Community organizer and musician; lives in University Heights, Ohio
  • Member of the Party for Socialism and Liberation since about 2022
